LinearStudy.linear_reindexed_actual_source_point.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} {τ : Type u_3} [Field K]
  [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (M : Matrix σ σ K) (hM : M.det ≠ 0) (e : τ ≃ σ) (x : σ → K) :
  have E := (LinearStudy.polynomialLinearChangeEquiv M hM).trans (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv K e.symm);
  (fun j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X j))) = M⁻¹.mulVec x ∘ ⇑e

LinearStudy.polynomial_coordinate_away_local_generators.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2}
  {τ : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [Field K] (E : MvPolynomial σ K ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial τ K) (x : σ → K)
  (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)) (G : ι → MvPolynomial σ K)
  (hs :
    let P := RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom;
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) (G i)))
  (p0 : MvPolynomial τ K)
  (hp0 : (MvPolynomial.eval fun j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X j))) p0 ≠ 0) :
  let y := fun j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X j));
  let P := RingHom.ker (LinearStudy.polynomialAwayPointEvaluation y p0 hp0).toRingHom;
  Ideal.map
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial τ K)
        (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.comap (algebraMap (MvPolynomial τ K) (Localization.Away p0)) P)))
      (Ideal.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom I) =
    Ideal.span
      (Set.range fun i =>
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial τ K)
            (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.comap (algebraMap (MvPolynomial τ K) (Localization.Away p0)) P)))
          (E (G i)))

LinearStudy.rational_target_origin_numerators_vanish.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [Field K] (x : σ → K)
  (p0 : MvPolynomial σ K) (hp0 : (MvPolynomial.eval x) p0 ≠ 0) (p : σ → MvPolynomial σ K)
  (hQP :
    RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval 0).toRingHom =
      Ideal.comap (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom
        (RingHom.ker (LinearStudy.polynomialAwayPointEvaluation x p0 hp0).toRingHom))
  (i : σ) : (MvPolynomial.eval x) (p i) = 0

LinearStudy.polynomial_equation_quotient_actual_point.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [Field K] (x : σ → K)
  (p : σ → MvPolynomial σ K) (hp : ∀ (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (p i) = 0) :
  ∃ q, x = fun i => q ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range p))) (MvPolynomial.X i))

LinearStudy.localized_annihilator_generator_at_equal_primes.{u_1} {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (u : R) (P Q : Ideal R)
  [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime] (hPQ : P = Q)
  (h :
    Submodule.annihilator (nilradical (Localization.AtPrime P)) =
        Ideal.span {(algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P)) u} ∧
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P)) u ≠ 0) :
  Submodule.annihilator (nilradical (Localization.AtPrime Q)) = Ideal.span {(algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)) u} ∧
    (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)) u ≠ 0

LinearStudy.polynomial_coordinate_socles_cover_maximal_ideals.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2}
  {τ : Type u_3} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (E : MvPolynomial σ K ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial τ K) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K))
  (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial τ K)) (hJ : J = Ideal.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom I) (Θ : MvPolynomial τ K)
  [Module.Finite K (MvPolynomial τ K ⧸ J)]
  (hloc :
    ∀ (x : ↑(MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K I)),
      ∃ q,
        ((fun i => (MvPolynomial.eval ↑x) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X i))) = fun i =>
            q ((Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (MvPolynomial.X i))) ∧
          have t :=
            (algebraMap (MvPolynomial τ K ⧸ J) (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker q.toRingHom)))
              ((Ideal.Quotient.mk J) Θ);
          Submodule.annihilator (nilradical (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker q.toRingHom))) = Ideal.span {t} ∧ t ≠ 0)
  (L : Ideal (MvPolynomial τ K ⧸ J)) [L.IsMaximal] :
  have t := (algebraMap (MvPolynomial τ K ⧸ J) (Localization.AtPrime L)) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk J) Θ);
  Submodule.annihilator (nilradical (Localization.AtPrime L)) = Ideal.span {t} ∧ t ≠ 0

LinearStudy.actual_target_normal_equations_unramified_pullback_parameters.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {r c : ℕ}
  [Nonempty (Fin r)] [Nonempty (Fin c)] (I P Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)) [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime]
  (x y : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → K) (hP : P = RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom)
  (hQ : Q = RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval y).toRingHom) (hIQ : I ≤ Q)
  (F : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (hQP : Q = Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.aeval F).toRingHom P)
  (hF : Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.aeval F).toRingHom I ≤ I) (G : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)
  (hG : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i))))
  (hlocal :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) (G i)))
  (H : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)
  (htarget :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) (H i)))
  (h0H : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval y) (H i) = 0)
  (hDH :
    ∀ (i : Fin c) (j : Fin r ⊕ Fin c),
      (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (H i)) = if j = Sum.inr i then 1 else 0)
  (hfinite :
    Algebra.EssFiniteType
      (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I)
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I))
  (hunram :
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified
      (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I)
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I)) :
  have a := fun i => MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i) - MvPolynomial.C (y (Sum.inl i));
  have T := fun i => (LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothReducedMap x G hG hJ) ((MvPolynomial.aeval F) (a i));
  Ideal.span (Set.range T) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin r) K) ∧
    IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff ((MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) (T i)))

LinearStudy.point_local_unramified_parameters_generate.{u_1, u_2} {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [CommRing R]
  (I P Q : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime]
  [IsLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P)) I)] (φ : R →+* R)
  (hQP : Q = Ideal.comap φ P) (hφ : Ideal.map φ I ≤ I)
  (hfinite :
    Algebra.EssFiniteType (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I)
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P)) I))
  (hunram :
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I)
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P)) I))
  (t : ι → Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I)
  (ht :
    Ideal.span (Set.range t) =
      Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I))
        (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q)) Q)) :
  Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (LinearStudy.pointLocalQuotientPullback I P Q φ hQP hφ) (t i)) =
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P)) I)

LinearStudy.smooth_actual_unramified_pullback_parameters.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {r c : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin c)]
  [Nonempty (Fin r)] (I P Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)) [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime] (x : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → K)
  (hP : P = RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom) (F : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)
  (hQP : Q = Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.aeval F).toRingHom P) (hF : Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.aeval F).toRingHom I ≤ I)
  (G : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (hG : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i))))
  (hlocal :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) (G i)))
  (hfinite :
    Algebra.EssFiniteType
      (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I)
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I))
  (hunram :
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified
      (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I)
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I))
  (a : Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)
  (ha :
    Ideal.span
        (Set.range fun i =>
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I))
            ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) (a i))) =
      Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I))
        (Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) Q)) :
  have T := fun i => (LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothReducedMap x G hG hJ) ((MvPolynomial.aeval F) (a i));
  Ideal.span (Set.range T) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin r) K) ∧
    IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff ((MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) (T i)))

LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap_eq_dehomogenize.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {n : ℕ}
  (H : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) : LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap H = LinearStudy.affineDehomogenize H

LinearStudy.polynomial_difference_matrix_right_zero.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
  (P : ι → MvPolynomial ι K) (D : Matrix ι ι (MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) K))
  (hD :
    (D.mulVec fun i => MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i) - MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr i)) = fun i =>
      (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) (P i) - (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr) (P i)) :
  Matrix.mulVec (fun i j => (LinearStudy.polynomialDoubleRightPoint 0) (D i j)) MvPolynomial.X = fun i =>
    P i - MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (P i))

LinearStudy.polynomial_difference_matrix_diagonal.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
  [DecidableEq ι] (P : ι → MvPolynomial ι K) (D : Matrix ι ι (MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) K))
  (hD :
    (D.mulVec fun i => MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i) - MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr i)) = fun i =>
      (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) (P i) - (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr) (P i))
  (hd : ∀ (i j : ι), LinearStudy.polynomialDoubleDiagonal (D i j) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (P i)) :
  let Q := MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range P);
  have pi := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P));
  LinearStudy.Annihilates (KaehlerDifferential.ideal K Q) ((LinearStudy.polynomialDoubleTensorMap P) D.det) ∧
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' K) ((LinearStudy.polynomialDoubleTensorMap P) D.det) =
      Matrix.det fun i j => pi ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (P i))

LinearStudy.affine_polynomial_low_degree_trace_pairing.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K]
  {n : ℕ} (P : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) (he : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), 0 < (P i).totalDegree)
  (hreg :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)
      (List.ofFn fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i)))
  (hz :
    MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K
        (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i))) =
      {0}) :
  have I := Ideal.span (Set.range P);
  let Q := MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K ⧸ I;
  have pi := Ideal.Quotient.mk I;
  ∃ p,
    (∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K), f.totalDegree < ∑ i, ((P i).totalDegree - 1) → p.functional (pi f) = 0) ∧
      ∀ (a : Q), p.functional (a * Matrix.det fun i j => pi ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (P i))) = (Algebra.trace K Q) a

LinearStudy.homogeneousComponent_mul_homogeneous.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K]
  (a p : MvPolynomial ι K) (n d : ℕ) (hp : p.IsHomogeneous d) :
  (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) (a * p) = if d ≤ n then (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (n - d)) a * p else 0

LinearStudy.homogeneous_ideal_bounded_representation.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K]
  {κ : Type u_3} [Fintype κ] (P : κ → MvPolynomial ι K) (d : κ → ℕ) (hP : ∀ (i : κ), (P i).IsHomogeneous (d i))
  (f : MvPolynomial ι K) (n : ℕ) (hf : f.IsHomogeneous n) (hI : f ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range P)) :
  ∃ a, ∑ i, a i * P i = f ∧ ∀ (i : κ), (a i).IsHomogeneous (n - d i) ∧ (¬d i ≤ n → a i = 0)

LinearStudy.totalDegree_strip_top.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K] (p : MvPolynomial ι K) (n : ℕ)
  (hn : 0 < n) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ n) : (p - (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) p).totalDegree < n

LinearStudy.finite_polynomial_quotient_bounded_representatives.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K]
  (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) [Module.Finite K (MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ I)] :
  ∃ B, ∀ (p : MvPolynomial ι K), ∃ r, r.totalDegree ≤ B ∧ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) p = (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) r

LinearStudy.finite_homogeneous_ideal_contains_large_degree.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K]
  (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) (hI : Ideal.IsHomogeneous (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι K) I)
  [Module.Finite K (MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ I)] : ∃ B, ∀ (n : ℕ), B < n → ∀ (p : MvPolynomial ι K), p.IsHomogeneous n → p ∈ I

LinearStudy.polynomial_top_reduction.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K] {κ : Type u_3} [Fintype κ]
  (P : κ → MvPolynomial ι K) (B : ℕ)
  (hB :
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      B < n →
        ∀ (p : MvPolynomial ι K),
          p.IsHomogeneous n →
            p ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i)))
  (p : MvPolynomial ι K) (hp : B < p.totalDegree) :
  ∃ r,
    r.totalDegree < p.totalDegree ∧
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P))) p = (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P))) r

LinearStudy.polynomial_top_reduction_bounded_representatives.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K]
  {κ : Type u_3} [Fintype κ] (P : κ → MvPolynomial ι K) (B : ℕ)
  (hB :
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      B < n →
        ∀ (p : MvPolynomial ι K),
          p.IsHomogeneous n →
            p ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i)))
  (p : MvPolynomial ι K) :
  ∃ r,
    r.totalDegree ≤ B ∧
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P))) p = (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P))) r

LinearStudy.polynomialQuotient_finite_of_top_zeroLocus.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K]
  [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite ι] {κ : Type u_3} [Fintype κ] (P : κ → MvPolynomial ι K)
  (hz :
    MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K
        (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i))) =
      {0}) :
  Module.Finite K (MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range P))

LinearStudy.affine_polynomial_bounded_normal_form.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K] {n : ℕ}
  (P : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) (he : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), 0 < (P i).totalDegree)
  (hreg :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)
      (List.ofFn fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i)))
  (hz :
    MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K
        (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i))) =
      {0})
  (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) :
  ∃ r,
    r.totalDegree ≤ ∑ i, ((P i).totalDegree - 1) ∧
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P))) f = (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P))) r

LinearStudy.affine_filtered_functional_descends.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K] {n : ℕ}
  (P : Fin n → MvPolynomial ι K)
  (hreg :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (MvPolynomial ι K)
      (List.ofFn fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i)))
  (D : ℕ)
  (hrep :
    ∀ (p : MvPolynomial ι K),
      ∃ r,
        r.totalDegree ≤ D ∧
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P))) p = (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P))) r)
  (rho :
    MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i)) →ₗ[K]
      K) :
  ∃ ell,
    (∀ (f : MvPolynomial ι K),
        f.totalDegree ≤ D →
          ell ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P))) f) =
            rho
              ((Ideal.Quotient.mk
                  (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i))))
                ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent D) f))) ∧
      ∀ (f : MvPolynomial ι K), f.totalDegree < D → ell ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range P))) f) = 0

LinearStudy.affine_polynomial_low_degree_functional.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [CharZero K] {n : ℕ}
  (P : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) (he : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), 0 < (P i).totalDegree)
  (hreg :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)
      (List.ofFn fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i)))
  (hz :
    MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K
        (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i))) =
      {0}) :
  have I := Ideal.span (Set.range P);
  have H := fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P i).totalDegree) (P i);
  have M := fun i j => MvPolynomial.C (↑(P i).totalDegree)⁻¹ * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (H i);
  ∃ ell,
    ell ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I) M.det) = 1 ∧

LinearStudy.constructed_normal_target_tangent_parameters.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3}
  [Field K] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K)) (x : α ⊕ β → K)
  (hIP : I ≤ RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom) (G : β → MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K)
  (hs :
    Ideal.map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom))) I =
      Ideal.span
        (Set.range fun i =>
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom)))
            (G i)))
  (h0 : ∀ (i : β), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i)))) :
  ∃ M,
    ∃ (hM : M.det ≠ 0),
      let Q := RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval (M⁻¹.mulVec x)).toRingHom;
      let I' := Ideal.map (LinearStudy.polynomialLinearChangeEquiv M hM).toRingEquiv.toRingHom I;
      ∃ (hIQ : I' ≤ Q),
        let J := Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I';
        Ideal.span
            (Set.range fun i =>
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)
                ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q))
                  (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i) - MvPolynomial.C (M⁻¹.mulVec x (Sum.inl i))))) =
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ J)

LinearStudy.projective_invariant_formal_parameter_jacobian_socle {n r c : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)

  (ψ : LinearStudy.CoordinateRing n →+* LinearStudy.AmbientRing r c) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 < c)
  (H : Fin c → LinearStudy.AmbientRing r c)
  (hcoord : Ideal.map ψ V.ideal.toIdeal = Ideal.span (Set.range MvPowerSeries.X))
  (hH : Ideal.map ψ (Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.aeval f.forms).toRingHom V.ideal.toIdeal) = LinearStudy.equationIdeal H)
  (τ : Fin r → LinearStudy.AmbientRing r c)
  (hτ :
    Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (τ i)) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (LinearStudy.ParameterRing r)) :
  have J := Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (Ideal.Quotient.mk (LinearStudy.equationIdeal H)) (τ i));
  let Q := LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H ⧸ J;
  have m := Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (nilradical (LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H));
  IsArtinianRing Q ∧
    m.IsMaximal ∧
      Submodule.annihilator m = Ideal.span {(Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (LinearStudy.relativeJacobian H)} ∧
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (LinearStudy.relativeJacobian H) ≠ 0

  (H : Fin (n + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K) (hzero : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (H i) = 0)
  [IsArtinianRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H))]
  (P : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) (hpzero : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (P i) = 0)
  (hp : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H))) ↑(P i) = 0) :
  let Q := MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) K ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range H);
  have q := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range H));
  ∃ N,
    (N.mulVec MvPowerSeries.X = fun i => ↑(P i)) ∧
      ∃ M,
        LinearStudy.Annihilates (KaehlerDifferential.ideal K Q) M.det ∧
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' K) M.det = Matrix.det fun i j => q ↑((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (P i))) ∧
            (LinearStudy.pairingRightReduction (LinearStudy.powerSeriesQuotientAugmentation H hzero)) M.det = q N.det

LinearStudy.projective_exists_linear_projection_cone_fiber_card {n : ℕ}
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) :
  ∃ r P,
    r ≤ n ∧
      P ≠ 0 ∧
        P.natDegree = r ∧
          (∃ N, ∀ m > N, Polynomial.eval (↑m) P = ↑(LinearStudy.homogeneousQuotientHilbert V.ideal.toIdeal m)) ∧
            ∃ L,
              (∀ (i : Fin (r + 1)), MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (L i) 1) ∧
                Function.Injective ⇑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L) ∧
                  (LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L).Finite ∧
                    (∀ (v : LinearStudy.CoordinateVector n),
                        v ≠ 0 →
                          (∀ H ∈ V.ideal.toIdeal, (MvPolynomial.eval v) H = 0) →
                            (fun i => (MvPolynomial.eval v) (L i)) ≠ 0) ∧
                      let R := MvPolynomial (Fin (r + 1)) ℂ;
                      let A := LinearStudy.CoordinateRing n ⧸ V.ideal.toIdeal;
                      have φ := LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L;
                      ∃ c,
                        c ≠ 0 ∧
                          (∃ w, (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0) ∧
                            ∀ (w : Fin (r + 1) → ℂ),
                              (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0 →
                                w 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                  Nat.card { v // (fun i => (MvPolynomial.eval ↑v) (L i)) = w } = Module.finrank R A

LinearStudy.linear_projection_exists_generic_growth_comparison.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2}

LinearStudy.projective_exists_same_linear_section_generic_growth {n : ℕ}
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) :
  ∃ r P,
    r ≤ n ∧
      P ≠ 0 ∧
        P.natDegree = r ∧
          (∃ N, ∀ j > N, Polynomial.eval (↑j) P = ↑(LinearStudy.homogeneousQuotientHilbert V.ideal.toIdeal j)) ∧
            ∃ L,
              (∀ (i : Fin (r + 1)), MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (L i) 1) ∧
                Function.Injective ⇑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L) ∧
                  (LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L).Finite ∧
                    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin (r + 1)) ℂ;
                    let A := LinearStudy.CoordinateRing n ⧸ V.ideal.toIdeal;
                    have φ := LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L;
                    ∃ m B E c,
                      m = Module.finrank R A ∧

                                    Module.finrank ℂ

                          (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e.symm).toRingHom).comp
                      C.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
                    I =

LinearStudy.original_local_ideal_firstOrder_normal_form.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3}
  [Field K] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K))
  (x : α ⊕ β → K) (G : β → MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K)
  (hs :
    Ideal.map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom))) I =
      Ideal.span
        (Set.range fun i =>
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom)))
            (G i)))
  (h0 : ∀ (i : β), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i)))) :
  ∃ M,
    ∃ (hM : M.det ≠ 0),
      ∃ H,
        (∀ (i : β), H i - MvPowerSeries.X (Sum.inr i) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (α ⊕ β) K) ^ 2) ∧
          Ideal.map
              ((LinearStudy.formalPolynomialAtPoint (M⁻¹.mulVec x)).comp
                (LinearStudy.polynomialLinearChangeEquiv M hM).toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
              I =
            Ideal.span (Set.range H)

LinearStudy.original_local_ideal_normal_polynomial_generators.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2}
  {β : Type u_3} [Field K] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K))
  (x : α ⊕ β → K) (G : β → MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K)
  (hs :
    Ideal.map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom))) I =
      Ideal.span
        (Set.range fun i =>
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom)))
            (G i)))
  (h0 : ∀ (i : β), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i)))) :
  ∃ M,
    ∃ (hM : M.det ≠ 0),
      ∃ H,
        (∀ (i : β), (MvPolynomial.eval (M⁻¹.mulVec x)) (H i) = 0) ∧
          (∀ (i : β) (j : α ⊕ β),
              (MvPolynomial.eval (M⁻¹.mulVec x)) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (H i)) = if j = Sum.inr i then 1 else 0) ∧
            let Q := RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval (M⁻¹.mulVec x)).toRingHom;
            Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q))
                (Ideal.map (LinearStudy.polynomialLinearChangeEquiv M hM).toRingEquiv.toRingHom I) =
              Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) (H i))

LinearStudy.smooth_point_original_ideal_normal_polynomial_generators.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [Field K]
  [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (I P : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)) [P.IsPrime] (hIP : I ≤ P) (x : σ → K)
  (hP : P = RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom)
  (hI : Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I ≠ ⊥)
  [Algebra.FormallySmooth K
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I)] :
  ∃ r c,
    ∃ (_ : 0 < c),
      ∃ e M,
        ∃ (hM : M.det ≠ 0),
          ∃ H,
            r =
                Module.finrank
                  (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I)
                  Ω[Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I⁄K] ∧
              (∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval (M⁻¹.mulVec (x ∘ ⇑e))) (H i) = 0) ∧
                (∀ (i : Fin c) (j : Fin r ⊕ Fin c),
                    (MvPolynomial.eval (M⁻¹.mulVec (x ∘ ⇑e))) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (H i)) =
                      if j = Sum.inr i then 1 else 0) ∧
                  let Q := RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval (M⁻¹.mulVec (x ∘ ⇑e))).toRingHom;
                  Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q))
                      (Ideal.map
                        ((LinearStudy.polynomialLinearChangeEquiv M hM).toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
                          (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e.symm).toRingHom)
                        I) =
                    Ideal.span
                      (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) (H i))

LinearStudy.polynomial_coordinate_away_point_evaluation.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} {τ : Type u_3}
  [Field K] (E : MvPolynomial σ K ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial τ K) (x : σ → K) (p0 : MvPolynomial σ K)
  (hp0 : (MvPolynomial.eval x) p0 ≠ 0) :
  have y := fun j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X j));
  ∃ (hp0' : (MvPolynomial.eval y) (E p0) ≠ 0),
    (LinearStudy.polynomialAwayPointEvaluation y (E p0) hp0').comp ↑(LinearStudy.polynomialAwayCoordinateEquiv E p0) =
        LinearStudy.polynomialAwayPointEvaluation x p0 hp0 ∧
      Ideal.comap (LinearStudy.polynomialAwayCoordinateEquiv E p0).symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
          (RingHom.ker (LinearStudy.polynomialAwayPointEvaluation x p0 hp0).toRingHom) =
        RingHom.ker (LinearStudy.polynomialAwayPointEvaluation y (E p0) hp0').toRingHom

LinearStudy.polynomial_derivation_chain.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {K : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4}

LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap_C.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {r c : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin c)]
  (x : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → K) (G : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)
  (hG : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)

  (LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap x G hG hJ) (MvPolynomial.C a) = MvPowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.C a)

LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap_tangent_derivative.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {r c : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin c)]
  (x : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → K) (G : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)
  (hG : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i)))) (i : Fin r)
  (j : Fin c) :
  (MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) ((LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap x G hG hJ) (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i))) = 0

LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap_normal_chain.{u_1} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {r c : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin c)]
  (x : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → K) (G : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)
  (hG : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i))))
  (P : MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (j : Fin c) :
  (MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) ((LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap x G hG hJ) P) =
    ∑ k,
      (LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap x G hG hJ) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr k)) P) *
        (MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) ((LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap x G hG hJ) (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr k)))

LinearStudy.polynomial_diagonal_difference.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3}
  {ι : Type u_4} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (u v : MvPolynomial ι R →+* A)
  (π : A →+* B) (hC : ∀ (c : R), u (MvPolynomial.C c) = v (MvPolynomial.C c))
  (hX : ∀ (i : ι), π (u (MvPolynomial.X i)) = π (v (MvPolynomial.X i))) (p : MvPolynomial ι R) :
  ∃ a,
    u p - v p = ∑ i, a i * (u (MvPolynomial.X i) - v (MvPolynomial.X i)) ∧
      ∀ (i : ι), π (a i) = π (u ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) p))

LinearStudy.polynomial_diagonal_difference_degree.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
  [DecidableEq ι] (p : MvPolynomial ι K) :
  ∃ a,
    (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl) p - (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr) p =
        ∑ i, a i * (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i) - MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr i)) ∧
      (∀ (i : ι), LinearStudy.polynomialDoubleDiagonal (a i) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) p) ∧
        (∀ (i : ι), (a i).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree - 1) ∧ (p.totalDegree = 0 → ∀ (i : ι), a i = 0)

  (y : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → K) (hF : ∀ (i : Fin r ⊕ Fin c), F i - MvPolynomial.C (y i) ∈ J)
  (H : MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)

  (y : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → K) (hF : ∀ (i : Fin r ⊕ Fin c), F i - MvPolynomial.C (y i) ∈ J)
  (H : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)
  (htan : ∀ (i : Fin c) (j : Fin r), (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl j)) (H i)) = 0) :
  (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) ((MvPolynomial.aeval F) (H i))) =
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)
        (MvPolynomial.C (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (H i)))) *
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (F (Sum.inr i)))

LinearStudy.polynomial_pullback_normal_jacobian_image_factor.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [CommRing K]

  (F : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (y : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → K)
  (hF : ∀ (i : Fin r ⊕ Fin c), F i - MvPolynomial.C (y i) ∈ J) (H : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)

  (e : σ ≃ τ) (P : σ → MvPolynomial σ K) (q : ℕ)
  (hz : MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent q) (P i))) = {0}) :
  MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K
      (Ideal.span
        (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent q) ((MvPolynomial.renameEquiv K e) (P (e.symm i))))) =

LinearStudy.polynomial_reindex_exact_highest.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
  {n q : ℕ} (e : σ ≃ Fin n) (P : σ → MvPolynomial σ K) (hle : ∀ (i : σ), (P i).totalDegree ≤ q)
  (hz : MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent q) (P i))) = {0}) :
  have P' := fun i => (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv K e) (P (e.symm i));
  (∀ (i : Fin n), (P' i).totalDegree = q) ∧
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
        (List.ofFn fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P' i).totalDegree) (P' i)) ∧
      MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K
          (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (P' i).totalDegree) (P' i))) =
        {0}

LinearStudy.polynomial_reindexed_low_degree_pairing.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
  [CharZero K] {n q : ℕ} (e : σ ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (P : σ → MvPolynomial σ K) (hq : 0 < q)
  (hle : ∀ (i : σ), (P i).totalDegree ≤ q)
  (hz : MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent q) (P i))) = {0}) :
  have I := Ideal.span (Set.range P);
  let A := MvPolynomial σ K ⧸ I;
  ∃ p, ∀ (F : MvPolynomial σ K), F.totalDegree < (n + 1) * (q - 1) → p.functional ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I) F) = 0

LinearStudy.projective_iterates_actual_family_native_finite_reduced_cut {n : ℕ}
  (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n) (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree)
  (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints) (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (hproper : V.ideal.toIdeal ≠ ⊥)
  (x0 : Fin n → ℂ) (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  ∃ r P,
    r ≤ n ∧
      P ≠ 0 ∧
        P.natDegree = r ∧
          ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) = ↑r ∧
            (∃ N, ∀ j > N, Polynomial.eval (↑j) P = ↑(LinearStudy.homogeneousQuotientHilbert V.ideal.toIdeal j)) ∧
              ∃ L,
                ∃ (hL : ∀ (i : Fin (r + 1)), MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (L i) 1),
                  Function.Injective ⇑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L) ∧
                    (LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L).Finite ∧
                      ∃ d,
                        0 < d ∧
                          ↑d = ↑r.factorial * P.leadingCoeff ∧
                            ∀ (k : ℕ),
                              0 < r →
                                1 < (f.iterate k).degree →
                                  ∃ c,
                                    c ≠ 0 ∧
                                      (∃ w, (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0) ∧
                                        ∀ (w : Fin (r + 1) → ℂ),
                                          (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0 →
                                            LinearStudy.ProjectiveActualFamilyRelationConclusion (f.iterate k) V L w d ∧
                                              let C :=
                                                MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸
                                                  Ideal.map LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap.toRingHom
                                                    (LinearStudy.projectivePulledLinearSectionIdeal (f.iterate k) V L
                                                      w);
                                              w 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                IsReduced C ∧
                                                  Module.Finite ℂ C ∧
                                                    Nonempty
                                                        (LinearStudy.projectivePulledLinearSectionScheme (f.iterate k) V
                                                            L hL w ≅
                                                          AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧C) ∧
                                                      AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced
                                                        (LinearStudy.projectivePulledLinearSectionScheme (f.iterate k) V
                                                          L hL w)

LinearStudy.projective_total_invariance_actual_affine_point_data {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hf : f.degree ≠ 0) (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet)

              Ideal.map (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom V.affineIdeal ∧

  [Nonempty ι] (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hV : V.ideal.toIdeal ≠ ⊥) (x : ι → Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx : ∀ (a : ι), LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint (x a) ∈ V.zeroSet)
  [∀ (a : ι), Algebra.IsSmoothAt ℂ (V.affinePoint (x a) ⋯).asIdeal] :
  ∃ r c,
    ∃ (hc : 0 < c),
      ∃ e M,
        ∃ (hM : M.det ≠ 0),
          ∃ G,
            have C := LinearStudy.polynomialLinearChangeEquiv M hM;
            have y := fun a => M⁻¹.mulVec (x a) ∘ ⇑e;
            have H := fun a i => (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e.symm) (C (G a i));
            ∃ (hH : ∀ (a : ι) (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval (y a)) (H a i) = 0) (hJ :
              ∀ (a : ι),
                IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval (y a)) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (H a i)))),
              ∀ (a : ι),
                Ideal.map
                    (((LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap (y a) (H a) ⋯ ⋯).comp
                          (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e.symm).toRingHom).comp
                      C.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
                    V.affineIdeal =

LinearStudy.projective_iterates_whole_ambient_fibers_common_geometry {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)

  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (hproper : V.ideal.toIdeal ≠ ⊥) (x0 : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  ∃ r ≤ n,
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) = ↑r ∧
      Module.finrank (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) Ω[MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal⁄ℂ] = r ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          let F := f.iterate k;
          let B := MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal;
          let A := Localization.Away (LinearStudy.projectiveChartDenominator F V);
          have φ := LinearStudy.projectiveChartOpenMap F V ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ x0 hx0;
          ∃ p ∉ V.affineIdeal,
            (∀ (P : PrimeSpectrum A),
                φ ((Ideal.Quotient.mk V.affineIdeal) p) ∉ P.asIdeal →
                  P ∈ Algebra.smoothLocus ℂ A ∧
                    PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.toRingHom P ∈ Algebra.smoothLocus ℂ B ∧ P ∈ Algebra.unramifiedLocus B A) ∧
              (∃ y, LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval y) p ≠ 0) ∧
                ∀ (y : Fin n → ℂ) (hy : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet),
                  (MvPolynomial.eval y) p ≠ 0 → LinearStudy.ProjectiveWholeAmbientFiberConclusion (f.iterate k) V y hy r

  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree) (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints)
  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) :
  let A := LinearStudy.CoordinateRing n ⧸ V.ideal.toIdeal;
  have γ := LinearStudy.projectiveCoordinateFractionMap f V hq hf hV;
  ∃ P C,
    P ≠ 0 ∧
      C ≠ 0 ∧
        P.natDegree ≤ n ∧
          C.natDegree = P.natDegree + 1 ∧
            Module.finrank (↥γ.fieldRange) (FractionRing A) = f.degree ^ C.natDegree ∧
              ∃ K,
                ∀ N > K,
                  Polynomial.eval (↑N) P = ↑(LinearStudy.homogeneousQuotientHilbert V.ideal.toIdeal N) ∧
                    Polynomial.eval (↑N) C =
                      ↑(Module.finrank ℂ ↥(LinearStudy.homogeneousQuotientFiltration V.ideal.toIdeal N))

LinearStudy.projectiveAmbientChart_unramified_at_affine_coordinates {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree) (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints)
  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (x0 : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet)
  (ρ : Localization.Away (LinearStudy.projectiveChartDenominator f V) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ)
  (hρ :
    have φ := LinearStudy.projectiveChartOpenMap f V hq hf hV x0 hx0;
    LinearStudy.rationalPointPrime ρ ∈
      Algebra.unramifiedLocus (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal)
        (Localization.Away (LinearStudy.projectiveChartDenominator f V)))
  (x : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx :
    (ρ.comp
            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal)
              (Localization.Away (LinearStudy.projectiveChartDenominator f V)))).comp
        (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ V.affineIdeal) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval x)
  (hp0 : (MvPolynomial.eval x) (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms 0)) ≠ 0) :
  let p0 := LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms 0);
  let p := fun i => LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms i.succ);
  let J := Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) (Localization.Away p0)) V.affineIdeal;
  let P := RingHom.ker (LinearStudy.polynomialAwayPointEvaluation x p0 hp0).toRingHom;
  let Q := Ideal.comap (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom P;
  have hI := ⋯;
  (LinearStudy.generalPointLocalQuotientPullback V.affineIdeal J P Q
      (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom ⋯ hI).FormallyUnramified

                  0 < r →
                    1 < (f.iterate k).degree →
                      LinearStudy.ProjectiveWholeAmbientFiberConclusion (f.iterate k) V y hy r ∧
                        let S := MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (LinearStudy.projectiveAffineFiberIdeal (f.iterate k) V y);

                          ∀ (v : ↑S → LinearStudy.CoordinateVector n) (hv : ∀ (x : ↑S), v x ≠ 0),
                            (∀ (x : ↑S), Projectivization.mk ℂ (v x) ⋯ = LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint ↑x) →

                                (∀ (x : ↑S), weights x ≠ 0) ∧
                                  ∀ (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ),
                                    P.IsHomogeneous (r * ((f.iterate k).degree - 1) - 1) →
                                      ∑ x, weights x * (MvPolynomial.eval (v x)) P = 0

LinearStudy.projectiveChartOpenMap_rational_point_coordinates {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree) (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints)
  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (x0 : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet)
  (ρ : Localization.Away (LinearStudy.projectiveChartDenominator f V) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ) (x : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx :
    (ρ.comp
            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal)
              (Localization.Away (LinearStudy.projectiveChartDenominator f V)))).comp
        (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ V.affineIdeal) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval x) :
  have p0 := LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms 0);
  have p := fun i => LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms i.succ);
  (MvPolynomial.eval x) p0 ≠ 0 ∧
    (ρ.comp (LinearStudy.projectiveChartOpenMap f V hq hf hV x0 hx0)).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ V.affineIdeal) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => (MvPolynomial.eval x) (p i) / (MvPolynomial.eval x) p0

LinearStudy.projectiveChartOpenMap_exists_good_affine_coordinates {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree) (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints)
  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (x0 : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  let B := MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal;
  let A := Localization.Away (LinearStudy.projectiveChartDenominator f V);
  have φ := LinearStudy.projectiveChartOpenMap f V hq hf hV x0 hx0;
  have ι := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℂ B A;
  ∃ ρ x,
    ∃ (hx : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x ∈ V.zeroSet) (_ :
      (MvPolynomial.eval x) (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms 0)) ≠ 0),
      have y := fun i =>
        (MvPolynomial.eval x) (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms i.succ)) /
          (MvPolynomial.eval x) (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms 0));
      ∃ (hy : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet),
        Algebra.IsSmoothAt ℂ (V.affinePoint x hx).asIdeal ∧
          Algebra.IsSmoothAt ℂ (V.affinePoint y hy).asIdeal ∧
            LinearStudy.rationalPointPrime ρ ∈ Algebra.unramifiedLocus B A ∧
              (ρ.comp ι).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ V.affineIdeal) = MvPolynomial.aeval x ∧
                (ρ.comp φ).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ V.affineIdeal) = MvPolynomial.aeval y

LinearStudy.projective_iterates_general_whole_fiber_degree {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)

  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (x0 : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  let B := MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal;
  let L := FractionRing B;
  have γ := LinearStudy.projectiveChartFractionMap f V hq hf hV x0 hx0;
  have D := Module.finrank (↥γ.fieldRange) L;
  0 < D ∧
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      ∃ p ∉ V.affineIdeal,
        (∃ y, LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval y) p ≠ 0) ∧

            LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet →
              (MvPolynomial.eval y) p ≠ 0 →
                ((f.iterate k).onPoints ⁻¹' {LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y}).Finite ∧
                  Nat.card ↑((f.iterate k).onPoints ⁻¹' {LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y}) = D ^ k

    I ≤ Q ∧
      Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) I =
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) (H i))) :
  have z := M⁻¹.mulVec (y ∘ ⇑b.symm);
  have p0 := E (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms 0));
  have p := fun j => E (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms (b.symm j).succ));
  have pC := fun i => (MvPolynomial.aeval p) (M⁻¹.toMvPolynomial i) - MvPolynomial.C (z i) * p0;
  let A := MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range pC);
  have Θ := Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (pC (Sum.inr i));
  Module.Finite ℂ A ∧
    ∀ (x : ↑(MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (LinearStudy.projectiveAffineFiberIdeal f V y))),
      have x' := fun j => (MvPolynomial.eval ↑x) (E.symm (MvPolynomial.X j));
      ∃ q,
        (x' = fun i => q ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range pC))) (MvPolynomial.X i))) ∧
          have t :=
            (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker q.toRingHom)))
              ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range pC))) Θ);
          Submodule.annihilator (nilradical (Localization.AtPrime (RingHom.ker q.toRingHom))) = Ideal.span {t} ∧ t ≠ 0

LinearStudy.homogeneousComponent_aeval_positive_degree_all.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {κ : Type u_3}

LinearStudy.projectivePulledLinearSection_exists_finite_reduced_localKoszul_cuts {n r : ℕ}
  (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n) (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n)
  (hproper : V.ideal.toIdeal ≠ ⊥) (hq : 0 < f.degree) (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints)
  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (L : Fin (r + 1) → LinearStudy.CoordinateRing n)
  (hL : ∀ (i : Fin (r + 1)), MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (L i) 1)
  (hinj : Function.Injective ⇑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L))
  (hfinite : (LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L).Finite)
  (hdim : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) = ↑r) (x0 : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  ∃ c,
    c ≠ 0 ∧
      (∃ w, (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ (w : Fin (r + 1) → ℂ),
          (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0 →
            have I :=
              Ideal.map LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap.toRingHom
                (LinearStudy.projectivePulledLinearSectionIdeal f V L w);
            let C := MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ I;
            w 0 ≠ 0 ∧
              IsReduced C ∧
                Module.Finite ℂ C ∧
                  Nonempty (LinearStudy.projectivePulledLinearSectionScheme f V L hL w ≅ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧C) ∧
                    AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced (LinearStudy.projectivePulledLinearSectionScheme f V L hL w) ∧
                      ∀ x ∈ MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ I,
                        ∃ (hx : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x ∈ V.zeroSet),
                          let p := (V.affinePoint x hx).asIdeal;
                          let R := Localization.AtPrime p;
                          have H := fun i =>
                            (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) R)
                              ((Ideal.Quotient.mk V.affineIdeal)
                                (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap
                                  ((MvPolynomial.aeval f.forms) (LinearStudy.projectiveLinearSectionForms L w i))));
                          RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R (List.ofFn H) ∧
                            ∀ (j : ℕ),
                              0 < j → HomologicalComplex.ExactAt (koszulComplex (Fintype.linearCombination R H)) j

LinearStudy.projective_iterates_simultaneous_linear_section_fiber_relations {n : ℕ}
  (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n) (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree)
  (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints) (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (hproper : V.ideal.toIdeal ≠ ⊥)
  (x0 : Fin n → ℂ) (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  ∃ r P,
    r ≤ n ∧
      P ≠ 0 ∧
        P.natDegree = r ∧
          ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) = ↑r ∧
            (∃ N, ∀ j > N, Polynomial.eval (↑j) P = ↑(LinearStudy.homogeneousQuotientHilbert V.ideal.toIdeal j)) ∧
              ∃ L,
                (∀ (i : Fin (r + 1)), MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (L i) 1) ∧
                  Function.Injective ⇑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L) ∧
                    (LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L).Finite ∧
                      ∃ d,
                        0 < d ∧
                          ↑d = ↑r.factorial * P.leadingCoeff ∧
                            ∀ (k : ℕ),
                              0 < r →
                                1 < (f.iterate k).degree →
                                  ∃ c,
                                    c ≠ 0 ∧
                                      (∃ w, (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0) ∧
                                        ∀ (w : Fin (r + 1) → ℂ),
                                          (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0 →
                                            w 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                              Nat.card ↑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearSection V L w) = d ∧
                                                ∀ z ∈ LinearStudy.projectiveLinearSection V L w,
                                                  Projectivization.rep z 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                    have y := fun i =>
                                                      Projectivization.rep z i.succ / Projectivization.rep z 0;
                                                    ∃ (hy : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet),
                                                      LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y = z ∧
                                                        LinearStudy.ProjectiveWholeAmbientFiberConclusion (f.iterate k)
                                                            V y hy r ∧
                                                          LinearStudy.ProjectiveWholeFiberHomogeneousRelationConclusion
                                                            (f.iterate k) V y r

LinearStudy.projective_iterates_simultaneous_whole_point_fiber_relations {n : ℕ}
  (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n) (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree)
  (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints) (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (hproper : V.ideal.toIdeal ≠ ⊥)
  (x0 : Fin n → ℂ) (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  ∃ r P,
    r ≤ n ∧
      P ≠ 0 ∧
        P.natDegree = r ∧
          ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) = ↑r ∧
            (∃ N, ∀ j > N, Polynomial.eval (↑j) P = ↑(LinearStudy.homogeneousQuotientHilbert V.ideal.toIdeal j)) ∧
              ∃ L,
                (∀ (i : Fin (r + 1)), MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (L i) 1) ∧
                  Function.Injective ⇑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L) ∧
                    (LinearStudy.projectiveLinearNormalizationMap V L).Finite ∧
                      ∃ d,
                        0 < d ∧
                          ↑d = ↑r.factorial * P.leadingCoeff ∧
                            ∀ (k : ℕ),
                              0 < r →
                                1 < (f.iterate k).degree →
                                  ∃ c,
                                    c ≠ 0 ∧
                                      (∃ w, (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0) ∧
                                        ∀ (w : Fin (r + 1) → ℂ),
                                          (MvPolynomial.eval w) c ≠ 0 →
                                            w 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                              Nat.card ↑(LinearStudy.projectiveLinearSection V L w) = d ∧
                                                ∀ z ∈ LinearStudy.projectiveLinearSection V L w,
                                                  Projectivization.rep z 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                    let y := fun i =>
                                                      Projectivization.rep z i.succ / Projectivization.rep z 0;
                                                    ∃ (hy : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet),
                                                      LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y = z ∧
                                                        Nat.card
                                                              ↑((f.iterate k).onPoints ⁻¹'
                                                                  {LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y}) =
                                                            (f.degree ^ k) ^ r ∧
                                                          let S :=
                                                            (f.iterate k).onPoints ⁻¹'
                                                              {LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y};
                                                          ∃ (hS : S.Finite),
                                                            ∀ (v : ↑S → LinearStudy.CoordinateVector n)
                                                              (hv : ∀ (x : ↑S), v x ≠ 0),
                                                              (∀ (x : ↑S), Projectivization.mk ℂ (v x) ⋯ = ↑x) →
                                                                ∃ weights,
                                                                  (∀ (x : ↑S), weights x ≠ 0) ∧
                                                                    ∀ (σ : LinearStudy.CoordinateRing n),
                                                                      MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous σ
                                                                          (r * ((f.iterate k).degree - 1) - 1) →
                                                                        ∑ x, weights x * (MvPolynomial.eval (v x)) σ = 0

LinearStudy.projective_smooth_points_common_coordinates_actual_dimension.{u_1} {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι]
  [Nonempty ι] (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hproper : V.ideal.toIdeal ≠ ⊥) (x : ι → Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx : ∀ (a : ι), LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint (x a) ∈ V.zeroSet)
  [∀ (a : ι), Algebra.IsSmoothAt ℂ (V.affinePoint (x a) ⋯).asIdeal] :
  ∃ r c,
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) = ↑r ∧
      Module.finrank (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal) Ω[MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal⁄ℂ] = r ∧
        c = n - r ∧
          ∃ (hc : 0 < c),
            ∃ e M,
              ∃ (hM : M.det ≠ 0),
                ∃ G,
                  have C := LinearStudy.polynomialLinearChangeEquiv M hM;
                  have y := fun a => M⁻¹.mulVec (x a) ∘ ⇑e;
                  have H := fun a i => (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e.symm) (C (G a i));
                  ∃ (hH : ∀ (a : ι) (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval (y a)) (H a i) = 0) (hJ :
                    ∀ (a : ι),
                      IsUnit
                        (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval (y a)) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (H a i)))),
                    (∀ (a : ι),
                        Ideal.map
                            (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ)
                              (Localization.AtPrime
                                (Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk V.affineIdeal) (V.affinePoint (x a) ⋯).asIdeal)))
                            V.affineIdeal =
                          Ideal.span
                            (Set.range fun i =>
                              (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ)
                                  (Localization.AtPrime
                                    (Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk V.affineIdeal) (V.affinePoint (x a) ⋯).asIdeal)))
                                (G a i))) ∧
                      ∀ (a : ι),
                        Ideal.map
                            (((LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothFormalMap (y a) (H a) ⋯ ⋯).comp
                                  (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e.symm).toRingHom).comp
                              C.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
                            V.affineIdeal =
                          Ideal.span (Set.range MvPowerSeries.X)

          (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap

          have φ := LinearStudy.projectiveChartOpenMap F V ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ x0 hx0;
          ∃ p ∉ V.affineIdeal,

                φ ((Ideal.Quotient.mk V.affineIdeal) p) ∉ P.asIdeal →
                  P ∈ Algebra.smoothLocus ℂ A ∧
                    PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.toRingHom P ∈ Algebra.smoothLocus ℂ B ∧ P ∈ Algebra.unramifiedLocus B A) ∧
              (∃ y, LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval y) p ≠ 0) ∧

                      LinearStudy.ProjectiveLinearTargetParameterConclusion V y hy r

LinearStudy.projective_smooth_local_pullback_structure {n r c : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin c)]
  (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n) (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hf : 1 < f.degree)
  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (e : Fin (n + 1) ≃ Fin r ⊕ Fin c) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 < c)
  (P Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ)) [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime] (x : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → ℂ)
  (hP : P = RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom) (G H : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ)
  (hG : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i))))
  (hQ :
    Q =
      RingHom.ker
        (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i =>
            (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ e) (f.forms (e.symm i)))).toRingHom)
  (hsource :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime P))
        (Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ e).toRingEquiv.toRingHom V.ideal.toIdeal) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime P)) (G i)))
  (htarget :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime Q))
        (Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ e).toRingEquiv.toRingHom V.ideal.toIdeal) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) (H i))) :
  have F := fun i => (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ e) (f.forms (e.symm i));
  have L := LinearStudy.smoothPullbackEquations x G hG hJ F H;
  RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (LinearStudy.AmbientRing r c) (List.ofFn L) ∧
    Module.Finite (LinearStudy.ParameterRing r) (LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection L) ∧
      Module.Free (LinearStudy.ParameterRing r) (LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection L)

LinearStudy.projective_smooth_local_parameter_jacobian_socle {n r c : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin c)]
  (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n) (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hf : 1 < f.degree)
  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (e : Fin (n + 1) ≃ Fin r ⊕ Fin c) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 < c)
  (P Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ)) [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime] (x : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → ℂ)
  (hP : P = RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom) (G H : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ)
  (hG : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i))))
  (hQ :
    Q =
      RingHom.ker
        (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i =>
            (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ e) (f.forms (e.symm i)))).toRingHom)
  (hsource :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime P))
        (Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ e).toRingEquiv.toRingHom V.ideal.toIdeal) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime P)) (G i)))
  (htarget :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime Q))
        (Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ e).toRingEquiv.toRingHom V.ideal.toIdeal) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) (H i)))
  (τ : Fin r → LinearStudy.AmbientRing r c)
  (hτ :
    Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (τ i)) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (LinearStudy.ParameterRing r)) :
  have F := fun i => (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv ℂ e) (f.forms (e.symm i));
  have L := LinearStudy.smoothPullbackEquations x G hG hJ F H;
  have J := Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (Ideal.Quotient.mk (LinearStudy.equationIdeal L)) (τ i));
  let A := LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection L ⧸ J;
  have m := Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (nilradical (LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection L));
  IsArtinianRing A ∧
    m.IsMaximal ∧
      Submodule.annihilator m = Ideal.span {(Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (LinearStudy.relativeJacobian L)} ∧
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (LinearStudy.relativeJacobian L) ≠ 0

      φ ((Ideal.Quotient.mk V.affineIdeal) b) ∉ P.asIdeal →
        P ∈ Algebra.smoothLocus ℂ A ∧
          PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.toRingHom P ∈ Algebra.smoothLocus ℂ B ∧ P ∈ Algebra.unramifiedLocus B A)
  (y z : Fin n → ℂ) (hy : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet)
  (hz : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint z ∈ V.zeroSet) (hb : (MvPolynomial.eval y) b ≠ 0)
  (hfy : f.onPoints (LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint z) = LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y) :
  let B := MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal;
  let A := Localization.Away (LinearStudy.projectiveChartDenominator f V);
  have φ := LinearStudy.projectiveChartOpenMap f V hq hf hV x0 hx0;
  ∃ (hp0 : (MvPolynomial.eval z) (LinearStudy.affineChartPolynomialMap (f.forms 0)) ≠ 0),
    Algebra.IsSmoothAt ℂ (V.affinePoint z hz).asIdeal ∧
      Algebra.IsSmoothAt ℂ (V.affinePoint y hy).asIdeal ∧
        LinearStudy.rationalPointPrime (LinearStudy.projectiveChartPointEvaluation f V z hz hp0) ∈
            Algebra.unramifiedLocus B A ∧
          ((LinearStudy.projectiveChartPointEvaluation f V z hz hp0).comp φ).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℂ V.affineIdeal) =
            MvPolynomial.aeval y

LinearStudy.projectiveAffineFiber_whole_point_equiv_action {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (y : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hy : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet) (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet)
  (hchart :
    ∀ (v : LinearStudy.CoordinateVector n) (hv : v ≠ 0),
      f.onPoints (Projectivization.mk ℂ v hv) = LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y → v 0 ≠ 0) :
  ∃ e,
    ∀ (a : ↑(MvPolynomial.zeroLocus ℂ (LinearStudy.projectiveAffineFiberIdeal f V y))),

LinearStudy.projective_whole_point_fiber_arbitrary_representative_relation {n r : ℕ}
  (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n) (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (y : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hy : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet) (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet)
  (hchart :
    ∀ (v : LinearStudy.CoordinateVector n) (hv : v ≠ 0),
      f.onPoints (Projectivization.mk ℂ v hv) = LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y → v 0 ≠ 0)
  (hrel : LinearStudy.ProjectiveWholeFiberHomogeneousRelationConclusion f V y r) :
  have S := f.onPoints ⁻¹' {LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y};
  ∃ (hS : S.Finite),
    ∀ (v : ↑S → LinearStudy.CoordinateVector n) (hv : ∀ (x : ↑S), v x ≠ 0),
      (∀ (x : ↑S), Projectivization.mk ℂ (v x) ⋯ = ↑x) →
        ∃ weights,
          (∀ (x : ↑S), weights x ≠ 0) ∧
            ∀ (P : LinearStudy.CoordinateRing n),
              MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous P (r * (f.degree - 1) - 1) → ∑ x, weights x * (MvPolynomial.eval (v x)) P = 0

LinearStudy.projective_exists_whole_reduced_fiber {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree) (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints)
  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (x0 : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  ∃ y,
    LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet ∧
      (f.onPoints ⁻¹' {LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y}).Finite ∧
        (∀ (v : LinearStudy.CoordinateVector n) (hv : v ≠ 0),
            f.onPoints (Projectivization.mk ℂ v hv) = LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y → v 0 ≠ 0) ∧
          Module.Finite ℂ (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ LinearStudy.projectiveAffineFiberIdeal f V y) ∧
            IsReduced (MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ LinearStudy.projectiveAffineFiberIdeal f V y)

LinearStudy.projective_exists_whole_reduced_tensor_fiber_point_count {n : ℕ} (f : LinearStudy.HomogeneousEndomorphism n)
  (V : LinearStudy.IntegralProjectiveEquations n) (hq : 0 < f.degree) (hf : Function.Surjective f.onPoints)
  (hV : f.onPoints ⁻¹' V.zeroSet = V.zeroSet) (x0 : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hx0 : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint x0 ∈ V.zeroSet) :
  ∃ y,
    ∃ (hy : LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y ∈ V.zeroSet),
      (f.onPoints ⁻¹' {LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y}).Finite ∧
        (∀ (v : LinearStudy.CoordinateVector n) (hv : v ≠ 0),
            f.onPoints (Projectivization.mk ℂ v hv) = LinearStudy.normalizedProjectivePoint y → v 0 ≠ 0) ∧
          let B := MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ ⧸ V.affineIdeal;
          let A := Localization.Away (LinearStudy.projectiveChartDenominator f V);
          let φ := LinearStudy.projectiveChartOpenMap f V hq hf hV y hy;
          have ρ := V.affinePointEvaluation y hy;
          Module.Finite ℂ (TensorProduct B A ℂ) ∧
            IsReduced (TensorProduct B A ℂ) ∧

                Module.finrank ℂ (TensorProduct B A ℂ)

        (Set.range fun i =>
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) p')))
            (H i)))
  (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e)
  (hlo :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.Away p0)) J ^ e ≤
      Ideal.map (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom I)
  (hhi :
    Ideal.map (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom I ≤
      Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) ℂ) (Localization.Away p0)) J) :
  have HF := fun i =>
    (LinearStudy.polynomialAwaySmoothFormalMap x p0 hp0 G hG hJ) ((LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p) (H i));
  ∃ a,
    have τ := fun i =>
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (LinearStudy.equationIdeal HF))
        ((LinearStudy.polynomialAwaySmoothFormalMap x p0 hp0 G hG hJ)
          ((LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p) (a i)));
    have L := Ideal.span (Set.range τ);
    let C := LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection HF ⧸ L;
    have m := Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk L) (nilradical (LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection HF));
    IsArtinianRing C ∧
      m.IsMaximal ∧
        Submodule.annihilator m = Ideal.span {(Ideal.Quotient.mk L) (LinearStudy.relativeJacobian HF)} ∧
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk L) (LinearStudy.relativeJacobian HF) ≠ 0

  (htarget :

  (hH0 : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval 0) (H i) = 0)

LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap_unramified_target_linear_coordinates.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2}
  [Field K] [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (M : Matrix σ σ K) (hM : M.det ≠ 0) (p0 : MvPolynomial σ K)
  (p : σ → MvPolynomial σ K) (I Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)) [Q.IsPrime] (J P : Ideal (Localization.Away p0))
  [P.IsPrime] (hQP : Q = Ideal.comap (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom P)
  (hφ : Ideal.map (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom I ≤ J)
  (h :
    (LinearStudy.generalPointLocalQuotientPullback I J P Q (LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 p).toRingHom hQP
        hφ).FormallyUnramified) :
  have E := LinearStudy.polynomialLinearChangeEquiv M hM;
  let Q' := Ideal.comap E.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom Q;
  let ψ := LinearStudy.rationalPolynomialChartMap p0 fun i => (MvPolynomial.aeval p) (M⁻¹.toMvPolynomial i);
  ∃ (hQP' : Q' = Ideal.comap ψ.toRingHom P) (hψ : Ideal.map ψ.toRingHom (Ideal.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom I) ≤ J),
    (LinearStudy.generalPointLocalQuotientPullback (Ideal.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom I) J P Q' ψ.toRingHom hQP'
        hψ).FormallyUnramified

  [Field K] [PerfectField K] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra K R] [Algebra K A]
  [Algebra.FinitePresentation K R] [Algebra.FinitePresentation K A] (φ : R →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Injective ⇑φ)
  (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A) (a : A) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hs : Algebra.Smooth K (Localization.Away a))
  (hu : ((algebraMap A (Localization.Away a)).comp φ.toRingHom).FormallyUnramified) :
  ∃ c,

          φ c ∉ P.asIdeal →

LinearStudy.polynomial_equations_adapted_linear_coordinates.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {K : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3}
  [Field K] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (G : β → MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) K) (x : α ⊕ β → K)
  (h0 : ∀ (i : β), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i)))) :
  ∃ M,
    M.det ≠ 0 ∧
      have y := M⁻¹.mulVec x;
      have H := fun i => (LinearStudy.polynomialLinearChange M) (G i);
      (∀ (i : β), (MvPolynomial.eval y) (H i) = 0) ∧
        (∀ (i : β) (j : α), (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inl j)) (H i)) = 0) ∧
          ∀ (i j : β),
            (MvPolynomial.eval y) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (H i)) =
              (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i))

      ∃ H,
        (∀ (i : β), H i - MvPowerSeries.X (Sum.inr i) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (α ⊕ β) K) ^ 2) ∧

LinearStudy.formalThickening_relativeJacobian_socle {r c : ℕ} (H : Fin c → LinearStudy.AmbientRing r c) (hr : 0 < r)
  (hc : 0 < c) (hrad : (LinearStudy.equationIdeal H).radical = Ideal.span (Set.range MvPowerSeries.X)) :
  have q := LinearStudy.coordinateThickeningReductionFromRadical H hc hrad;
  (∀ (x : LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H),
      LinearStudy.Annihilates (nilradical (LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H)) x ↔
        ∃ b, x = b • LinearStudy.relativeJacobian H) ∧
    ∀ (τ : Fin r → LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H),
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => q (τ i)) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (LinearStudy.ParameterRing r) →
        have J := Ideal.span (Set.range τ);
        let Q := LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H ⧸ J;
        have m := Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (nilradical (LinearStudy.CompleteIntersection H));
        IsArtinianRing Q ∧
          m.IsMaximal ∧
            Submodule.annihilator m = Ideal.span {(Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (LinearStudy.relativeJacobian H)} ∧
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (LinearStudy.relativeJacobian H) ≠ 0

LinearStudy.smooth_local_unramified_parameters_generate.{u_1, u_2} {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {r c : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin c)]
  [Nonempty (Fin r)] (I P : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)) [P.IsPrime] (x : Fin r ⊕ Fin c → K)
  (hP : P = RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom) (G : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K)
  (hG : ∀ (i : Fin c), (MvPolynomial.eval x) (G i) = 0)
  (hJ : IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (Sum.inr j)) (G i))))
  (hlocal :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) (G i)))
  (R : Type u_2) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
  [Algebra R
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I)]
  [IsLocalHom
      (algebraMap R
        (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I))]
  [Algebra.EssFiniteType R
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I)]
  [Algebra.FormallyUnramified R
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I)]
  (t : Fin r → R) (ht : Ideal.span (Set.range t) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
  let S := Localization.AtPrime P ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin r ⊕ Fin c) K) (Localization.AtPrime P)) I;
  have φ := LinearStudy.polynomialSmoothLocalQuotientReduction I P x hP G hG hJ hlocal;
  have T := fun i => φ ((algebraMap R S) (t i));
  Ideal.span (Set.range T) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin r) K) ∧
    IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff ((MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) (T i)))

  [Module R M] (S : Type u_3) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (i : ℕ) (m : Fin i → M) :
  (exteriorPower.baseChangeIso R M S i) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (exteriorPower.ιMulti R i) m) =
    (exteriorPower.ιMulti S i) (⇑((TensorProduct.mk R S M) 1) ∘ m)

exteriorPower.baseChangeIso_symm_apply_tmul.{u_1, u_2, u_3} (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup M]
  [Module R M] (S : Type u_3) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (i : ℕ) (s : Fin i → S) (m : Fin i → M) :
  (exteriorPower.baseChangeIso R M S i).symm ((exteriorPower.ιMulti S i) fun j => s j ⊗ₜ[R] m j) =
    (∏ j, s j) ⊗ₜ[R] (exteriorPower.ιMulti R i) m

ExteriorAlgebra.algebraMapInv_ι.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  (x : M) : ExteriorAlgebra.algebraMapInv ((ExteriorAlgebra.ι R) x) = 0

ExteriorAlgebra.algebraMapInv_algebraMap.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

ExteriorAlgebra.ιInv_ι.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (x : M) :
  ExteriorAlgebra.ιInv ((ExteriorAlgebra.ι R) x) = x

ExteriorAlgebra.ιInv_one.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :

ExteriorAlgebra.ιInv_algebraMap.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  (r : R) : ExteriorAlgebra.ιInv ((algebraMap R (ExteriorAlgebra R M)) r) = 0

ExteriorAlgebra.ι_mul_ι_ring.{u} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (a b : R) :

ExteriorAlgebra.eq_algebraMap_add_ι.{u} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (t : ExteriorAlgebra R R) :
  t =
    (algebraMap R (ExteriorAlgebra R R)) (ExteriorAlgebra.algebraMapInv t) +
      (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R) (ExteriorAlgebra.ιInv t)
ExteriorAlgebra.prodRingEquiv.{u} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] : (R × R) ≃ₗ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R R

ExteriorAlgebra.prodRingEquiv_apply.{u} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (c : R × R) :
  ExteriorAlgebra.prodRingEquiv c = (algebraMap R (ExteriorAlgebra R R)) c.1 + (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R) c.2

ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivProd.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
  (ExteriorAlgebra R M × ExteriorAlgebra R M) ≃ₗ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R (M × R)

ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivProd_apply.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  (x y : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
  (ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivProd R M) (x, y) =
    (ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R M R)) x +
      (ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R M R)) y * (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R) (0, 1)

ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivProd_comp_inl.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
  ↑(ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivProd R M) ∘ₗ LinearMap.inl R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) (ExteriorAlgebra R M) =
    ↑(ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R M R))

ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivProd_apply_snd.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
  (ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivProd R M) (0, a) =
    (ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R M R)) a * (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R) (0, 1)

ExteriorAlgebra.ι_mul_mem_exteriorPower_anticomm.{u, u_1} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M]
  [Module R M] {k : ℕ} {w : ExteriorAlgebra R M} (hw : w ∈ ⋀[R]^k M) (z : M) :
  (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R) z * w = (-1) ^ k • (w * (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R) z)

ExteriorAlgebra.exists_decomp.{u, u_1} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (i : ℕ)
  (z : ExteriorAlgebra R (M × R)) :
  z ∈ ⋀[R]^(i + 1) (M × R) →
    ∃ x ∈ ⋀[R]^(i + 1) M,
      ∃ y ∈ ⋀[R]^i M,
        z =
          (ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R M R)) x +
            (ExteriorAlgebra.map (LinearMap.inl R M R)) y * (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R) (0, 1)

ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivProd_mem_exteriorPower.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M]
  [Module R M] (i : ℕ) (x y : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :

exteriorPowerProdEquivProd.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (i : ℕ) :
  (↥(⋀[R]^(i + 1) M) × ↥(⋀[R]^i M)) ≃ₗ[R] ↥(⋀[R]^(i + 1) (M × R))

exteriorPowerProdEquivProd_apply_coe.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  (i : ℕ) (x : ↥(⋀[R]^(i + 1) M)) (y : ↥(⋀[R]^i M)) :
  ↑((exteriorPowerProdEquivProd R M i) (x, y)) = (ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivProd R M) (↑x, ↑y)

exteriorPowerProdEquivProd_apply_inl_ιMulti.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M]
  [Module R M] (i : ℕ) (m : Fin (i + 1) → M) :

exteriorPowerProdEquivProd_comp_inl.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  (i : ℕ) :
  ↑(exteriorPowerProdEquivProd R M i) ∘ₗ LinearMap.inl R ↥(⋀[R]^(i + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^i M) =

exteriorPowerProdEquivProd_apply_inr_ιMulti.{u, u_1} (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M]

  ↑((exteriorPowerProdEquivProd R M i) (0, (exteriorPower.ιMulti R i) m)) =

koszulComplex.dAlternating.{u, v} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (φ : M →ₗ[R] R)

koszulComplex.dAlternating_apply.{u, v} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n + 1) → M) :

koszulComplex.map_dAlternating_apply.{u, v} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) {N : Type v} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (φ' : N →ₗ[R] R) (h : φ' ∘ₗ f = φ) (i : ℕ)

koszulComplex.map_d_comm.{u, v} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (φ : M →ₗ[R] R)

koszulComplex.map_comp.{u, v} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (φ : M →ₗ[R] R)
  {N : Type v} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {L : Type v} [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (φ' : N →ₗ[R] R)
  (g : N →ₗ[R] L) (φ'' : L →ₗ[R] R) (h : φ' ∘ₗ f = φ) (h' : φ'' ∘ₗ g = φ') (h'' : φ'' ∘ₗ g ∘ₗ f = φ) :

koszulComplex.appendMap_d_eq_pos.{u, v} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

  koszulComplex.d (koszulComplex.appendMap φ a) (n + 1) ∘ₗ ↑(exteriorPowerProdEquivProd R M (n + 1)) =
    ↑(exteriorPowerProdEquivProd R M n) ∘ₗ
      (LinearMap.inl R ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^n M) ∘ₗ
            koszulComplex.d φ (n + 1) ∘ₗ LinearMap.fst R ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1 + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) +

        (-1) ^ (n + 1) •
          a • LinearMap.inl R ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^n M) ∘ₗ LinearMap.snd R ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1 + 1) M) ↥(⋀[R]^(n + 1) M))
